a2 == 0: clear the two flag bits by ANDing this[59] (offset 0xEC) with 0xFF9FFFFF.
a2 == 1: clear the two flag bits with 0xFF9FFFFF, OR in bit 0x200000, and store the result back to this[59].
a2 == 2: clear the two flag bits with 0xFF9FFFFF, OR in bit 0x400000, and store back to this[59].
Return the original flag selector a2 in every branch.
